gen-gf-oxanium-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans reads modern and tightly packed, its bowls left open on one side and barely any step up to capitals. Oxanium above it is the loud one, all commanding monoline strokes.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-ramabhadra: Oxanium brings a commanding display voice, its monoline arms and legs holding one width throughout, while Ramabhadra stays clean beneath it. Its prominent x-height keeps a plain sans text easy going.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-rambla: Neutral and clean, Rambla keeps its small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, while Oxanium above it draws curves meeting stems with no swelling. Bump the Rambla size up a notch if it feels cramped.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-recursive: Oxanium opens with distinctive, commanding display letters, tall in the lowercase and drawn in uninterrupted monoline strokes. And Recursive follows with an approachable sans, its tall mean line and direction-proof thickness making paragraphs feel friendly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-roboto-condensed: Contemporary and compact, Roboto Condensed packs words with barely visible gaps so lines glide under the eye like wire. Make Oxanium small and its commanding presence fades, so give it room.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified even at modest sizes. Its unvarying weight from word to word gives the pair a steady backbone, which Oxanium's distinctive, high-lowercase display strokes then punch up.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-secular-one: Commanding from the top, Oxanium draws its monoline strokes with a high lowercase and curves that finish in clear daylight. Secular One then fills each line with a dominant midsection and zero modulation, so a plain sans paragraph feels dense and heavy.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans reads clean and compressed, with a high-set midline, an s that opens generously, and gaps that nearly vanish between letters. Oxanium shares its flat, unmodulated line weight, which is what ties them.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed brings an approachable, contemporary body, with pen-lifted curves that leave loops unfinished and a big x-height squeezed under tight ascenders. Oxanium's commanding monoline display strokes sit above it and give the page a firm head.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-spline-sans-mono: Oxanium takes the commanding lead with big lowercase and uninterrupted monoline strokes, tall and distinctive. Spline Sans Mono follows in fixed-width, code-style letters, bold and precise, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
